notes.title: Unleashing Bloodmoon: The Restless Dead Rise!
notes.content:
[h1]The Restless Dead Awaken – A Legion Stirs in Bloodmoon[/h1][p]From the dust of forgotten battlefields, ancient defenders rise once more. These skeletal warriors, once noble protectors, now march without purpose across the cursed lands. Their brittle bones may crack, but their resolve is unyielding. Bound by ancient oaths, they are husks of honor twisted into eternal servitude.[/p][p]Beware, for where the Skeletons march, only echoes of duty and death remain.

[/p][h2]A Relentless Army of Bones[/h2][p][/p][p]Neither flesh nor mercy remains in these hollow shells. Armed with rusted blades and battered shields, their empty sockets burn with the will of a forgotten master. They do not rest, they do not fear, and they cannot be bargained with.[/p][p][/p][p]Those who stand against them will find themselves outnumbered and overwhelmed, for the Skeletons know no retreat.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299834/383fe6b24ac9a516addad200f2bb3aa1717859ad.png"][/img]
[/p][h2]Gameplay Insight: Face the Skeleton Horde[/h2][p][/p][p]Unlike the cunning Vampire Queen or the chaotic Forsaken Dead, the Skeletons rely on their numbers and discipline. They fight as one, swarming the unprepared with relentless strikes.[/p][list][*][p][b]Strengths:[/b] Unyielding, numerous, and hard to stagger.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weaknesses:[/b] Their brittle bones shatter under blunt force.[/p][/*][/list][p]A single Skeleton may be weak, but together, they are a tide of death.

[/p][h2]Will You Withstand the March of Bones?[/h2][p][/p][p]Only those who adapt can survive the onslaught. Take up your hammer, shatter their ranks, and hold your ground—or be consumed by their endless advance.[/p][p]☑️ Add [b]Bloodmoon[/b] to your Steam Wishlist to stay updated!
☑️ Join our Discord and share your strategies with fellow hunters![/p][p]The darkness grows… will you endure the march of the Restless Dead?[/p]

notes.title: Unleashing Bloodmoon: Meet the Mistress of Shadows!
notes.content:
[h1] The Mistress of Shadows Awakens – A New Threat Rises in Bloodmoon[/h1]

The cursed lands of [i]Bloodmoon[/i] grow even darker as an ancient horror emerges from the abyss. She is veiled in beauty, yet drenched in malice—a predator of the night whose whispers can ensnare even the strongest of wills. Beware, for the Vampire Queen has awakened.  

[h2]A Sovereign of Blood and Darkness[/h2]

Once a ruler of mortals, now an eternal queen of the damned, she feeds on the lifeblood of the living, her hunger insatiable. Few who meet her gaze live to tell the tale, and those who do… are never the same again.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299834/163f3b5bdbfe7986fee7f995cbdedba5c653dd67.png[/img]

[h2]Gameplay Insight: Face the Vampire Queen[/h2]

Lethal Grace – Unlike the shambling Forsaken Dead, the Vampire Queen is swift, deadly, and immune to lightning.
  
She is not just another enemy—she is the predator, and you are the prey.  

[h2]Will You Survive the Night?[/h2]

Only the most prepared warriors will stand a chance. Stock up on holy relics, sharpen your blades, and be ready to fight for your soul.  

📜 Add Bloodmoon to your Steam Wishlist to stay updated!  
💀 Join our Discord and share your strategies with fellow hunters.  

The darkness is spreading… Are you strong enough to face what lurks within?
